title: Shrink by 2: even gaps never mix the halves
notes: Small values sit in the even slots and big ones in the odd slots. Halving gives gaps 8, 4 and 2, all even, so no pass compares an even slot with an odd one and nothing moves. Gap-1 passes then do all the work: 11 passes and 154 comparisons. Shrinking by 1.3 takes 8 passes and 90.
